idea-plugin.name: Agent Helper
idea-plugin.description: Adds Send to Codex to the editor's right-click menu and to the toolbar that floats above a selection. It pastes one project-relative reference to the current file (path/to/File.kt), with the selected lines when there is a selection (path/to/File.kt#L10-L20), into every Codex CLI instance running in the current project's Terminal while keeping focus in the editor.

action.description: Paste a reference to this file into the Codex CLI running in the Terminal
